statements.impact_statement: golang.org/x/net v0.57.0 is reported in these images because it is compiled into the upstream OpenTofu 1.13.9 release binary they install at /opt/terragucci/tofu-1.13.9/tofu (tofu_1.13.9_linux_amd64.tar.gz sha256 b34b327cc1ef07178207b6f2cd1f5276537d3e5b7be316500f6dac50d4c0a857, tofu_1.13.9_linux_arm64.tar.gz sha256 5dc196dde75b667e4806d358310ec96742774cd0993c54c1237efee5644b69b8). The double flow-control refund is in x/net's own HTTP/2 server, http2/server.go (serverConn.closeStream and requestBody.Read). In x/net v0.57.0 that file builds only under the constraint !(go1.27 && !http2legacy). OpenTofu 1.13.9 is built with Go 1.27.3 and no build tags, so http2/server.go is not compiled: x/net's http2.Server is the wrapper in http2/server_wrap.go around net/http's own server, which Go 1.27.2 fixed for this advisory. The function tables of both release binaries hold x/net http2 framing, client and transport code and no x/net server function (no serverConn, requestBody, Server or ConfigureServer). The statement covers this advisory in OpenTofu 1.13.9's x/net v0.57.0 only; delete it when the images move to an OpenTofu release built with golang.org/x/net v0.60.0 or later.
